title: Lester rejoins in 1933 and gets long solos
summary: King Oliver and Pete Jones brought Lester back in about May 1933; he stayed until November and played all the solos he wanted.

story.theme_name: Playing with Count Basie: joining, leading, leaving
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: So you were saying about Lester joining King Oliver's band after the Blue Devils broke up in Virginia.

Well, when they went to Kansas City looking for a tenor player, they found him, and they brought him back, to the surprise of all of us. Because we all knew him, because he'd been with the band with Bronson. Because most of the same guys...
You say "they" found him. Who found him?
They found him and they brought him in.
How long did he stay then?
Did King Oliver give him much solo space?
Sure. He played all he want.
